prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A futuristic, cyberpunk-inspired scene set in a neon-lit, high-tech environment. In the foreground, a stocky, middle-aged man with a serious expression sits in a wheelchair, dressed in modern military tactical gear including a helmet, glasses, and a thick scarf. His gloved hand is raised, gesturing assertively toward a figure just out of frame. The man’s wheelchair is robust and armored, with the word “GENOVITO” emblazoned on the armrest. 

Behind him, a striking figure with a computer monitor for a head stands, the screen displaying a green-tinted, expressive human face. This character wears a flowing, white, futuristic dress that billows dramatically, adding a sense of motion and surrealism. To the right, only the lower half of another character is visible, clad in metallic, armored boots and green leggings, suggesting a powerful, possibly robotic presence.

The background is awash with vibrant neon blues and purples, featuring glowing rings and abstract light trails that evoke a sense of advanced technology and digital space. The lighting is dynamic, with cool, luminous highlights and soft shadows, creating a cinematic, high-contrast look. The camera angle is slightly low and close, emphasizing the stature and presence of the central figure while capturing the layered depth of the scene. The overall style blends realism with stylized, imaginative elements, reminiscent of a high-budget sci-fi film or a concept art piece for a video game, with a focus on character, mood, and futuristic world-building.
